column1: # Test shader packs, pinned. Columns (tab-separated): modrinth slug, version id, version, file name, sha512.
# scripts/fetch-testpacks.sh downloads them into run/testpacks/. Never commit the packs themselves:
# most of these licenses forbid redistribution (only MakeUp is LGPL; Mellow and Miniature are MIT).
# Picked 2026-11-20 (versions rechecked 2026-11-23) from Modrinth's shader list, sorted by downloads. Complementary Unbound isn't
